usageNotes: Returns all webhook notification endpoints configured cluster-wide. Use this to audit outbound HTTP targets before creating or modifying notification matchers. Requires 'Mapping.Audit' on '/mapping/notifications'; header and secret values are base64-encoded in the response, so decode before display.

examples.summary: List all webhook endpoints to audit configured targets

tips: The 'secret' field values are returned base64-encoded; decode with atob() or base64 -d before comparing.
Check the 'disable' field — disabled endpoints silently drop notifications even when referenced by an active matcher.
The 'origin' field distinguishes user-created endpoints from built-in or modified-builtin ones; built-in endpoints cannot be deleted.
Use the 'name' field values here as references when calling get/update/delete operations on individual webhook endpoints.
